name: @apelles/inspector
description: Apelles Global Inspector shared chrome (D-103, Phase 4 of docs/notes/global-inspector.md). Tiny, presentation-only primitives (empty state, section heading) shared between @apelles/motion's InspectorPanel and @apelles/editor's ClipInspectorPanel — no @apelles/ui dependency (packages/motion can't use that barrel, see Button.tsx's doc comment), no Tauri, no tab-specific imports, so neither tab package depends on the other.
